name: Michael P. Lyons
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: One of the founding partners of the Dallas-based trial firm Lyons & Simmons, Michael P. Lyons is an award-winning trial attorney who focuses primarily on representing victims and their families in complex, catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death cases. He is licensed to practice before both state and federal courts in Texas and New Mexico, and has handled a wide range of personal injury and wrongful death matters that include fires and explosions, commercial vehicle crashes, aviation disasters, oilfield accidents, drilling rig fires, pipeline explosions, defective products, and electrocutions. With over 25+ years experience, Lyons has been recognized as one of the top plaintiffs' personal injury and wrongful death lawyers in the United States by a variety of publications including US News & World Report, National Law Journal, Courtroom View Network, VerdictSearch, The Best Lawyers in America, Super Lawyers, D Magazine and Lawdragon.

Lyons has a national reputation for securing outstanding results for his clients in record setting cases. Since 2023 alone, Lyons has obtained verdicts, awards and settlements totaling more than a billion dollars on behalf of his clients in catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death matters in Texas and all over the United States. He is a member of the million dollar and multi-million dollar advocates forum, achieved lifetime achievement status from America's Top 100 Attorneys and has been recognized as one of the top 100 attorneys in the state of Texas by Super Lawyers.
